changelog: - **Selecting a frame lets go of the nodes selected before it, so Delete removes the frame.** A node or connection stayed selected when a frame was then clicked, and Delete or Backspace removed that node instead of the frame. A frame clicked (or chosen with Enter or Space) is now the only thing selected. Only a press on the frame's border with Shift, Ctrl or ⌘ held keeps the earlier selection, as before.
